_help: Version B 'Information' tab for art stations. Texts from the thesis Notion page (Stockholms tunnelbana – highlights). complexity: 1 easy, 2 medium (branch / easy to miss), 3 complex. photo: file in assets/b/stations/ (credits in credits.json there). discoverUrl: page opened by DISCOVER (null = not built yet). tip / lines / duration / complexity from the thesis Notion page "斯德哥尔摩地铁重点整理" (what to look for, metro lines, suggested stay).

T-Centralen|Stockholm.description: Blue-and-white cave walls with climbing vines and silhouettes of the workers who built the metro.
T-Centralen|Stockholm.tip: Follow the Blå linjen signs down to the blue line platforms: the platforms, the escalators and the blue-and-white cave.

Kungsträdgården|Stockholm.description: An underground excavation site in red, white and green, with sculptures and relics of Makalös Palace.
Kungsträdgården|Stockholm.tip: Don’t stop at the platform: walk the platform, the passages and the exit area too.

Solna centrum|Solna.description: A deep red cave ceiling above a green forest, about nature and society.
Solna centrum|Solna.tip: Take line 11 (Akalla branch) and walk the platform from one end to the other.

Solna strand|Solna.description: Blue 'sky' cubes set into the rock walls of a surreal cave.
Solna strand|Solna.tip: Take line 10 (Hjulsta branch) and look for the blue cubes set into the rock walls.

Tensta|Stockholm.description: Words in many languages about migration, solidarity and living together.
Tensta|Stockholm.tip: Look at both sides of the platform, the walls, the texts and the ceiling.

Hallonbergen|Sundbyberg.description: Children's drawings turned into walls full of childhood memories.
Hallonbergen|Sundbyberg.tip: Walk along the platform and look at the walls.

Husby|Stockholm.description: Colourful public art about the local community.
Husby|Stockholm.tip: Look at the platform and the cave walls.

Östermalmstorg|Stockholm.description: Siri Derkert's wall drawings on peace, women's rights and the environment.
Östermalmstorg|Stockholm.tip: Look at the platform walls. Going on to Tekniska högskolan? Take line 14 towards Mörby centrum.

Stadion|Stockholm.description: A vaulted ceiling painted in sweeping rainbow arcs.
Stadion|Stockholm.tip: Look up for the huge rainbow on the cave ceiling.

Tekniska högskolan|Stockholm.description: Science, space and geometry, with installations hanging from the ceiling.
Tekniska högskolan|Stockholm.tip: Don’t just photograph one wall: look at the platform, the ceiling and the hanging installations.

Mörby centrum|Danderyd.description: Wall colours that change as you move along the platform.
Mörby centrum|Danderyd.tip: Walk along the platform and look at the walls from different directions.

Universitetet|Stockholm.description: Tiles with words and images on science, nature and human rights: a station to read as you walk.
Universitetet|Stockholm.tip: Walk the platform and read the texts and images on the walls, tiles and passages.
